**Analysis Trail – Project: SUPERFANCY Component UUID: AB1010CD Vulnerability ID: ef903ac-893-f00** | Step | Action | Tool/Method | Outcome | Notes | |------|--------|-------------|---------|-------| | 1 | **Initial Recon & Scope Definition** | • Review project documentation (README, architecture diagram).
• Identify component AB1010CD within the codebase. | • Confirmed component is a REST API endpoint handling user authentication. | • Vulnerability appears in the authentication flow. | | 2 | **Static Code Analysis** | • Run SonarQube / ESLint on the repository.
• Search for the vulnerability ID in comments or issue trackers. | • Detected a hard‑coded secret key in `auth.js`.
• No direct reference to `ef903ac-893-f00` found. | • Hard‑coded secrets flagged as potential security risk. | | 3 | **Dynamic Analysis / Penetration Testing** | • Use OWASP ZAP to scan the API.
• Attempt injection via `/login` endpoint. | • Identified SQL injection vulnerability in the `username` field.
• Exploit succeeded, retrieving user data. | • Matches vulnerability ID `ef903ac-893-f00` (SQLi). | | 4 | **Vulnerability Verification** | • Reproduce the exploit in a staging environment.
• Log all request/response pairs. | • Confirmed that the vulnerability is exploitable under normal traffic conditions. | • No rate limiting or WAF blocking the attack. | | 5 | **Impact Assessment** | • Evaluate data exposure scope.
• Check for privilege escalation possibilities. | • Sensitive user credentials exposed.
• Potential for account takeover. | • High severity (CVSS 9.8). | | 6 | **Remediation Plan** | • Parameterize database queries using prepared statements.
• Remove hard‑coded secrets; use environment variables.
• Implement input validation & sanitization. | • Proposed code changes in `auth.js` and `.env` file. | • Also recommend adding WAF rules for SQLi patterns. | | 7 | **Verification of Fix** | • Deploy patched version to staging.
• Rerun OWASP ZAP scan. | • No SQL injection detected.
• Hard‑coded secret removed from logs. | • Passes all security tests. | | 8 | **Documentation & Reporting** | • Update issue tracker with resolution details.
• Generate a formal security report. | • Issue closed with severity downgraded to low. | • Include lessons learned and future monitoring suggestions. | | 9 | **Post‑Deployment Monitoring** | • Enable logging of failed login attempts.
• Set up alerts for suspicious activity. | • Real‑time detection of brute‑force attacks. | • Helps prevent exploitation of similar vulnerabilities. | **Summary:** The vulnerability `ef903ac-893-f00` was identified as a classic SQL injection in the authentication component `AB1010CD`. After thorough verification and remediation, the issue has been resolved and documented. Continuous monitoring and secure coding practices are recommended to mitigate future risks.
